name: The roster yard (a showcase for the testers, not a level of the game)
about: Javier & Claude, 2026-11-04. The rest of the team's roster (enemy roster v2), one at a time down a plain street so each trick shows on its own: the Wrench Mechanic (his toolbox by the wall), the Doorman, the Neon Dancer, the Enforcer, the lookout (who whistles in two more), the Grabber. Recorded by the bot with every build. Not in levels.json: the real levels place them (levels 4 to 9, the team's level list).
